what: float64 exact diagonal of the empirical neural tangent kernel of PDE residual rows, diag_b = |dr_b / d theta|^2 over every weight, bias and readout parameter of deep tanh MLPs u(z) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 z + b_1) ...) + bo (per-row gradient norms; block sums give the NTK loss-balancing weights), regime diag = (r, diag). Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.residual_gram.deep_residual_ntk_diagonal: with the cotangents Q_b and the input streams P_b of one reverse pass, |dr_b / dW|^2 = sum_(t,s) (P_b^T P_b)_ts (Q_b^T Q_b)_ts per layer (identity) or explicit rows per layer by a rule on T (in + R out) against R in out, at O(N) memory and without the N x N matrix. Every control forms per-row gradients: explicitly from the same stream cotangents, one point at a time by vmap(grad) through forward-Laplacian engines, Taylor mode or nested autodiff, or through the full Gram matrix and its diagonal where N <= 24,576. All eight cells have D <= H; the projected variant for D > H was calibrated separately and is not part of this run
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's diag program on a reduced instance (width 4, D_q = min(D, 5), B = 4 interior points (+ 1 boundary point), same depth and operator, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (Taylor series per coordinate direction, J by central differences in every parameter, diag = row norms): r and diag 1e-12 + 1e-10 max |ref|; the candidate and the independent reproduction pass both under the rule and with the identity forced on every layer; full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.gram_then_diagonal: the A26 module's full K = J J^T, then its diagonal; N x N memory, cells with N <= 24576
tiers.explicit_rows_from_shared_streams: the full J from one reverse pass of the summed residual, row norms; full-seed streams_J
tiers.per_row_forward_laplacian: vmap(grad) through one-point forward-Laplacian engines: rg_lib stream recursion, omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian, folx.forward_laplacian; row norms
tiers.nested_autodiff: vmap(grad) through jax.grad and jax.hessian, row norms

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
